notes: the east side renders the single noun qedem, headed on east by rule 31's subtraction test; the ASV's own gloss note on ketef concerns the other side and is not evidence here (rule 38).
The to before Riblah is supplied for a directional accusative and stays with the noun (rule 33), the article on ha-Riblah taking nothing since the ASV writes no the (rule 29).
